title: Cutting contests with Buddy Petit and other Black bands
summary: Wagon bands challenged each other; he did not hear Bunk Johnson or Oliver down there.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You have to go places to learn other things. Oh, of course, we used to meet like Buddy Batiste, we'd be an advertiser of color dance, we'd be advertising dance, we'd meet on the same corner, we'd challenge each other. Then they'd put one direction, we'd go another direction, we'd play, get over dirty with the instrument, you know?
Then maybe an hour or so later we'd meet on another street, another corner.
Yeah. You heard Buddy Batiste, I never got to hear him, he didn't make any records either.
Some people say he's as good as Louie.
I never heard Bunk Johnson down there, I never heard, what's this other guy, a Mark King of the Colors guy?
Well, I mean Joe Oliver down there.
And you heard him I guess when you were a kid.
